svg.title: The venue mode at a club or pub display
svg.desc: A tap on the tile of an account with a PIN asks for that PIN before anything changes; a wrong one changes nothing, and five in a row lock every PIN for a minute. Once a minute, the service worker looks whether the break is over. A match that runs counts as input, so a match is never interrupted, and a lobby that waits for players makes the break three times as long. After the break, the display switches to the house account, or signs out when none is set or it has to sign in again; either way the player before keeps their session parked.
